baslik: Which air fryer does AI recommend in Turkey? Local brand Fakir: zero #shorts
aciklama:
In 66 live-search AI answers from Turkey, Philips came up 56 times and Xiaomi 37 times; local brand Fakir never came up.

Highlights
• Ranking (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity; 66 answers): Philips 56, Xiaomi 37, Ninja 21, Karaca 18, Tefal 17, Arzum 12, Cosori 10, Fakir 0.
• Xiaomi led through the first 5 questions; Philips pulled ahead by question 7.
• Gemini recommended Cosori in 21 of 30 answers, Claude in 10 of 22; ChatGPT and Perplexity never mentioned it.
• Consistency score 84/100: we asked every question twice. Claude never changed its answer; ChatGPT and Perplexity changed on 3 of 11 questions.
• On Google Shopping ("airfryer" search), Xiaomi ranks 1st and Philips 2nd. Fakir is 10th there, yet AI never named it; Ninja isn't in the top 20 listings.

Questions this video answers
• Which air fryer brand does AI recommend in Turkey? Mostly Philips, then Xiaomi.
• Does the answer change with the question? Yes: for a model with a window, Xiaomi (5 of 6 answers); for warranty and service, Philips (6 of 6).
• Do AI and Google Shopping agree? No: Shopping puts Xiaomi first and lists Fakir 10th, while AI never names Fakir.
• Where does AI look? The most cited site was havafritozu.com (12 answers).

Method: Nov 22, 2026, Turkey, questions in Turkish. ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity answered 11 questions twice each with live web search (66 answers); Gemini answered from memory (30 answers). Small sample, not representative of the whole market.

These are the AI's answers, not our recommendation. This is an independent measurement; we have no sponsorship or partnership with any brand shown.
